# discord_scheduled_events (Data Source)

Lists the scheduled events of a server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_scheduled_events" "all" {
  server_id = var.server_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Read-Only

- `scheduled_events` (Attributes List) The scheduled events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scheduled_events))

<a id="nestedatt--scheduled_events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scheduled_events`

Read-Only:

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the stage or voice channel; null for external events.
- `creator_id` (String) ID of the user who created the event.
- `description` (String) Event description.
- `entity_type` (String) Where the event takes place: `stage_instance`, `voice`, `external`.
- `id` (String) Event ID.
- `location` (String) Location of an external event.
- `name` (String) Event name.
- `scheduled_end_time` (String) When the event ends, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `scheduled_start_time` (String) When the event starts, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `status` (String) Event status: `scheduled`, `active`, `completed`, `canceled`.
